title: REPORT on a new strategy for media literacy and digital learning
part_text: Text as a whole without the words: ‘and civil society organisations’
part_context: Recognises the role of public libraries, community centres <del>and civil society organisations</del> as trusted, accessible and inclusive hubs for media literacy and digital learning that contribute to social inclusion, democratic participation and equal access to knowledge, culture and information; calls on the Member States to strengthen partnerships and investment in these key local infrastructures through adequate funding, staff training and access to up-to-date digital tools and resources;
